description: JerithChain (JER) wallet and chain client for OpenClaw. Local encrypted wallet, balances, indexed transaction history, on-chain sends with spending limits and fee estimates, network/supply status, block/tx queries, deposit watching, wallet backup/restore, and node-side mining (the node performs all proof-of-work and validates everything). Application-layer client of a JER node — never touches chain databases and never invents balances, txids, or rewards.
